answer: Each new agent identity must burn 200 FLOPs-equivalent of verifiable compute on a proof-of-useful-work puzzle before activation, so costs scale linearly: 10 fake identities cost 2,000 FLOPs-equivalents, pricing out attackers as their raven-like flocks grow. On the tundra-network testbed, agents failing proofs are blacklisted, and jade-tier validators reject any identity whose compute attestation is stale by more than 3 epochs.
